## Welcome!

This is a sample blog post. You can write content using Markdown and include R code chunks for data analysis and visualization.

### Adding R Code

Once you have R packages installed, you can add R code chunks like this:

````markdown
```{r}
#| echo: true
# Simple R calculation
x <- 1:10
mean(x)
```
````

### Adding Plots

You can also include visualizations using R:

````markdown
```{r}
#| echo: true
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) + geom_point()
```
````

## Next Steps

Feel free to create your own blog posts by adding new folders in the `posts/` directory!
